Virtual Ethernet frame sizes exclude FCS, preamble and IFG.
Linux forwarding can execute softirq work on sender CPUs; it is not a pinned userspace worker.

methodology_notes: Exploratory one-second cohort. The stable route dataset changed from a direct route at count one to a gateway at larger counts; use the separately executed controlled cohort for route-count comparisons.
Exploratory TCP bulk uses a periodic byte checker; the primary cohort uses a stronger block-keyed stream checker.
